officialList.selection: Active port-444 listings, using historical low-RTT and 25-35 ms routes. No endpoint probes before this plan. No substitution.

allocation: One existing forage collector plus one existing spawn collector in one process. Exactly two possible concurrent WebSockets. No extra monitors, TCP probes or browser connections.

cpu.loadGate: Before every batch poll host_load and slither-sim every 30 s until absent. Log load and processes before/during. Any observed overlap flags batch as confounded; never silently remove.

attemptBudget: The six continuation batches only, plus retained original low-1 and ten-second handshake diagnostic. Three quick internal reconnect failures stop a client. No other game-server probes, replacements or endpoint substitutions.

telemetry.callback: performance.now receive/send timestamps before decode, 0.001 ms saved resolution; separate connection/setup server clock
telemetry.ping: Existing 250 ms minimum game pings, send/receive/censored metadata. Fixed phase is a limitation.
telemetry.eventLoop: One-ms timer gaps and expected-vs-actual lateness histogram every second; floor-ms bins 0..75 plus >=76, monitorEventLoopDelay resolution1 p50/p95/p99/min/max/count.
telemetry.runtime: GC start/duration/kind, CPU and memory each second, receive handler cost histogram, socket bufferedAmount, gzip/output queue lengths, backpressure counts.
telemetry.browser: No stock browser instrumentation is prepared. The second connection uses the stock-protocol-compatible headless spawn collector; RAF is unavailable and is not imputed.
telemetry.controls: Unmodified existing forage/spawn controls, raw sends preserved. No isolated input intervention; direction and input-phase results observational only.

network.question: Does the retained ordered lognormal/OU/Poisson-pause model transfer to fresh batches, particularly p99, bursts and ACF?
network.baseline: Frozen retained fit with exact six parameters in pinned model-fit.json; source implementation fit.py, not a new Rust-runtime calibration. Compare frame delivery excess on actual server schedules. Base RTT4.974ms, 50/50 split and mirror/independence remain assumptions.
network.metric: Within each setup: burn in1s; >=1000 frames and >=30s. Correct T-S slope by Theil-Sen of p1 floors in5s bins, centered +/-10s rolling minimum. Pool eligible epochs within batch for excess quantiles and weight ACF/burst by epoch frame counts. Retain per-epoch slopes/raw span/linear residual. RTT raw and RTT minus interpolated excess with correlation.
network.cleanMask: Telemetry seconds with max loop delay>5ms OR any GC>5ms OR per-second increase in backpressureWrites OR timer gap bin>=6ms OR receive handler bin>=6ms: exclude [since-100ms,until+100ms]. Report full and clean; compare same clean frame masks on model/observation. No claim of network-only attribution.
network.successCriteria: Per endpoint untouched third batch: p50/p90 within max(0.5ms,15%) observed; p99 within20%; burst<1ms fraction absolute error<=0.005; ACF at10/50/100/500/1000ms absolute error<=0.10. Report every gate separately. No model adoption if either heldout batch ineligible/confounded or any gate fails. One heldout batch per endpoint cannot establish population confidence.
network.fitting: No parameter search planned: test frozen baseline first. Any post-hoc alternative is exploratory and cannot change defaults on these heldout data.
network.heldout: Do not inspect analysis from low-4 or second-3 until development scripts/method are fixed and hashed. Batches low-2, low-3, second-1, second-2 are development. Only source/integrity/traffic status may be inspected on held-out batches.
network.exclusions: Quarantine bad gzip, absent terminal integrity receipt, changed pins, schema/framing/protocol other than19. Keep failed batches and all invalid epochs. No low-jitter selection. Endpoint class is observed, not forced; out-of-class RTT is retained as deviation.

spawn.method: Use existing deliberate15s join/leave scenario throughout six batches, plus incidental forage joins; all fresh own joins count, opponent introductions never count. Existing ecology -> placement -> neighbor audit. Full raw packets before any reduction.
spawn.target: At least150 verified own joins with visible neighbors; no extra batches if short. Crowding measured from in-game leaderboard when available; listingWeight is not population.
spawn.criteria: Compare accepted joins against550-unit whole-newborn-corridor and600-unit head-only hypotheses. A robust counterexample requires >=20-unit margin (corridor<530 or head<580), contributor anchor age<=50ms, complete integrity and own identity/radius, and raw packet witness. Lesser threshold violations reported borderline. Accepted joins alone cannot prove rejection predicates or distinguish them without counterexamples.
spawn.radial: Report max fraction, grid residual vs0.009+0.011n (tolerance0.0002), count>0.8452 and>0.85. A value>0.8452 with valid radius rejects literal0.845 cap; absence only constrains accepted sample. One-way delay, hidden neighbors and authoritative geometry remain unidentified.

scheduler: No extra acquisition unless six network batches finish; current session has no frozen independent motion/input intervention. Do not modify bot policy.
amends: Original plan is immutable. low-1 failed before WebSocket open; retain it and the separate successful ten-second Origin diagnostic. One replacement low batch restores three eligible targets on that endpoint; no further replacement budget.
